verdict.rationale: A single marketing line says you can plug in Datadog, Grafana, Prometheus, New Relic, Zabbix, Azure, AWS and Google Cloud, which covers three of the five named tools and AWS generically. The pack has no setup documentation for any of them. missing for 10: an explicit CloudWatch integration (only 'AWS' is named), any Sentry integration, documented setup guides for each integration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
